item.title: EIU changes 4 parking lots to be accessible for students
item.description: The Eastern Illinois University Parking Advisory Committee has reclassified four parking lots across campus so that they may be used for both staff and student parking. The lots that underwent this change include the east section of North X-Lot, W-Lot, Doudna East Staff Lot and the South Coleman Staff Lot, apart from the north row or handicap accessible spaces. item.description: Editor’s Note: This story is part of a Illinois’ 15th Congressional District candidates series.
